name: What should I prepare before requesting an estimate for a bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting an estimate for a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out to a contractor, clarify your primary goals, locate your home's main utilities, and measure candidate spaces. Determine whether the room needs a tub, a walk-in shower, or just a powder room setup. Note where your water heater, main sewer cleanout, and electrical panel are situated, as their location affects routing feasibility. Gathering reference photos for tile styles, vanity dimensions, and lighting helps clarify your design preferences early. Having a realistic budget range ready also allows your contractor to suggest practical layout and material alternatives during the initial walk-through.
acceptedAnswer.description: Determine whether you need a full or half bath, locate your electrical panel and main plumbing lines, measure potential spaces, and gather design reference photos.
